API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APISaaS Security APICASB DLP Rule Resource Add Rule
CASB DLP Rule Resource Add Rule
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/casbDlpRules

Adds a new SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule. .

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Information about the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule

type
string

The type of SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, OFLCASB_DLP_FILE, OFLCASB_DLP_EMAIL, OFLCASB_DLP_CRM, OFLCASB_DLP_ITSM, OFLCASB_DLP_COLLAB, OFLCASB_DLP_REPO, OFLCASB_DLP_STORAGE, OFLCASB_DLP_GENAI]

id
int32

System-generated identifier for the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule

order
int32
REQUIRED

Order of rule execution with respect to other SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rules

rank
int32

Admin rank that is assigned to this rule. Mandatory when admin rank-based access restriction is enabled.

name
string
REQUIRED

Rule name

state
string

Administrative state of the rule

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

cloudAppTenants
object[]
users
object[]
groups
object[]
departments
object[]
dlpEngines
object[]
action
string

The configured action for the policy rule

Possible values: [OFLCASB_DLP_REPORT_INCIDENT, OFLCASB_DLP_SHARE_READ_ONLY, OFLCASB_DLP_EXTERNAL_SHARE_READ_ONLY, OFLCASB_DLP_INTERNAL_SHARE_READ_ONLY, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_PUBLIC_LINK_SHARE, OFLCASB_DLP_REVOKE_SHARE, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_EXTERNAL_SHARE, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_INTERNAL_SHARE, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_COLLABORATORS, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_INTERNAL_LINK_SHARE, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_DISCOVERABLE, OFLCASB_DLP_NOTIFY_END_USER, OFLCASB_DLP_APPLY_MIP_TAG, OFLCASB_DLP_APPLY_BOX_TAG, OFLCASB_DLP_MOVE_TO_RESTRICTED_FOLDER, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE, OFLCASB_DLP_QUARANTINE, OFLCASB_DLP_APPLY_EMAIL_TAG, OFLCASB_DLP_APPLY_GOOGLEDRIVE_LABEL, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_EXT_COLLABORATORS, OFLCASB_DLP_QUARANTINE_TO_USER_ROOT_FOLDER, OFLCASB_DLP_APPLY_WATERMARK, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_WATERMARK, OFLCASB_DLP_APPLY_HEADER, OFLCASB_DLP_APPLY_FOOTER, OFLCASB_DLP_APPLY_HEADER_FOOTER, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_HEADER, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_FOOTER, OFLCASB_DLP_REMOVE_HEADER_FOOTER, OFLCASB_DLP_BLOCK, OFLCASB_DLP_APPLY_ATLASSIAN_CLASSIFICATION_LABEL, OFLCASB_DLP_ALLOW, OFLCASB_DLP_REDACT]

severity
string

The severity level of the incidents that match the policy rule

Possible values: [RULE_SEVERITY_HIGH, RULE_SEVERITY_MEDIUM, RULE_SEVERITY_LOW, RULE_SEVERITY_INFO]

description
string

An admin editable text-based description of the rule

fileTypes
string[]

File types for which the rule is applied. If not set, the rule is applied across all file types.

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, FTCATEGORY_JAVASCRIPT, FTCATEGORY_FLASH, FTCATEGORY_JAVA_APPLET, FTCATEGORY_ZIP, FTCATEGORY_GZIP, FTCATEGORY_TAR, FTCATEGORY_BZIP2, FTCATEGORY_RAR, FTCATEGORY_STUFFIT, FTCATEGORY_ISO, FTCATEGORY_CAB, FTCATEGORY_P7Z, FTCATEGORY_ADE, FTCATEGORY_DB2, FTCATEGORY_SQL, FTCATEGORY_DBF, FTCATEGORY_DB, FTCATEGORY_PYTHON, FTCATEGORY_POWERSHELL, FTCATEGORY_VISUAL_BASIC_SCRIPT, FTCATEGORY_BASH_SCRIPTS, FTCATEGORY_SHELL_SCRAP, FTCATEGORY_APPX, FTCATEGORY_MSC, FTCATEGORY_BITMAP, FTCATEGORY_PHOTOSHOP, FTCATEGORY_WINDOWS_META_FORMAT, FTCATEGORY_GIF, FTCATEGORY_JPEG, FTCATEGORY_PNG, FTCATEGORY_TIFF, FTCATEGORY_WINDOWS_SCRIPT_FILES, FTCATEGORY_ONENOTE, FTCATEGORY_MS_POWERPOINT, FTCATEGORY_MS_WORD, FTCATEGORY_MS_EXCEL, FTCATEGORY_MS_RTF, FTCATEGORY_MS_MDB, FTCATEGORY_MS_MSG, FTCATEGORY_MS_PST, FTCATEGORY_VSDX, FTCATEGORY_OAB, FTCATEGORY_ENCRYPT, FTCATEGORY_PDF_DOCUMENT, FTCATEGORY_POSTSCRIPT, FTCATEGORY_COMPILED_HTML_HELP, FTCATEGORY_TXT, FTCATEGORY_CSV, FTCATEGORY_STL, FTCATEGORY_CERT, FTCATEGORY_PCAP, FTCATEGORY_CER, FTCATEGORY_DER, FTCATEGORY_P7B, FTCATEGORY_PEM, FTCATEGORY_JKS, FTCATEGORY_KEY, FTCATEGORY_P12, FTCATEGORY_CHEMDRAW_FILES, FTCATEGORY_CML, FTCATEGORY_CP, FTCATEGORY_MM, FTCATEGORY_INF, FTCATEGORY_APPLE_DOCUMENTS, FTCATEGORY_AUTOCAD, FTCATEGORY_INTEGRATED_CIRCUIT_FILES, FTCATEGORY_LOG_FILES, FTCATEGORY_EML_FILES, FTCATEGORY_DAT, FTCATEGORY_INI, FTCATEGORY_UNK_TXT, FTCATEGORY_GO_FILES, FTCATEGORY_RUBY_FILES, FTCATEGORY_PERL_FILES, FTCATEGORY_MATLAB_FILES, FTCATEGORY_INCLUDE_FILES, FTCATEGORY_JAVA_FILES, FTCATEGORY_MAKE_FILES, FTCATEGORY_YAML_FILES, FTCATEGORY_VISUAL_BASIC_FILES, FTCATEGORY_C_FILES, FTCATEGORY_XAML, FTCATEGORY_BASIC_SOURCE_CODE, FTCATEGORY_SCT, FTCATEGORY_MS_CPP_FILES, FTCATEGORY_ASM, FTCATEGORY_BORLAND_CPP_FILES, FTCATEGORY_COBOL, FTCATEGORY_CSX, FTCATEGORY_DELPHI, FTCATEGORY_DMD, FTCATEGORY_DSP, FTCATEGORY_F_FILES, FTCATEGORY_NATVIS, FTCATEGORY_POD, FTCATEGORY_QLIKVIEW_FILES, FTCATEGORY_RES_FILES, FTCATEGORY_RPY, FTCATEGORY_RSP, FTCATEGORY_SAS, FTCATEGORY_SC, FTCATEGORY_SCALA, FTCATEGORY_TLH, FTCATEGORY_TLI, FTCATEGORY_VISUAL_CPP_FILES, FTCATEGORY_X1B, FTCATEGORY_IFC, FTCATEGORY_BCP, FTCATEGORY_FOR, FTCATEGORY_AU3, FTCATEGORY_MANIFEST]

collaborationScope
string[]

Collaboration scope for the rule

Possible values: [ANY, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_EXTERNAL_COLLAB_VIEW, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_EXTERNAL_COLLAB_EDIT, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_EXTERNAL_LINK_VIEW, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_EXTERNAL_LINK_EDIT, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_INTERNAL_COLLAB_VIEW, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_INTERNAL_COLLAB_EDIT, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_INTERNAL_LINK_VIEW, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_INTERNAL_LINK_EDIT, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_PRIVATE_EDIT, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_PRIVATE, COLLABORATION_SCOPE_PUBLIC]

contentLocation
string

The location for the content that the Zscaler service inspects for sensitive data

Possible values: [ANY, CONTENT_LOCATION_PRIVATE_CHANNEL, CONTENT_LOCATION_PUBLIC_CHANNEL, CONTENT_LOCATION_SHARED_CHANNEL, CONTENT_LOCATION_DIRECT_MESSAGE, CONTENT_LOCATION_MULTI_PERSON_DIRECT_MESSAGE]

domains
string[]

The domain for the external organization sharing the channel. This field is applicable only when you select CONTENT_LOCATION_SHARED_CHANNEL in the 'contentLocation' field.

objectTypes
object[]
components
string[]

List of components for which the rule is applied. Zscaler service inspects these components for sensitive data.

Possible values: [ANY, COMPONENT_EMAIL_BODY, COMPONENT_EMAIL_ATTACHMENT, COMPONENT_EMAIL_SUBJECT, COMPONENT_ITSM_OBJECTS, COMPONENT_ITSM_ATTACHMENTS, COMPONENT_CRM_CHATTER_MESSAGES, COMPONENT_CRM_ATTACHMENTS_IN_OBJECTS, COMPONENT_COLLAB_MESSAGES, COMPONENT_COLLAB_ATTACHMENTS, COMPONENT_CRM_CASES, COMPONENT_GENAI_MESSAGES, COMPONENT_GENAI_ATTACHMENTS, COMPONENT_FILE_ATTACHMENTS]

buckets
object[]
bucketOwner
string

A user who inspect their buckets for sensitive data. When you choose a user, their buckets are available in the Buckets field.

receiver
object
zscalerIncidentReceiver
object
externalAuditorEmail
string

Email address of the external auditor to whom the DLP email alerts are sent

auditor
object
auditorNotification
object
tag
object
watermarkProfile
object
watermarkDeleteOldVersion
boolean

A Boolean value that specifies whether to delete an old version of the watermarked file

numberOfInternalCollaborators
string

Selects the number of internal collaborators for files that are shared with specific collaborators or are discoverable within an organization

Possible values: [CASB_FILE_TYPE_COLLAB_COUNT_RANGE_1_TO_10, CASB_FILE_TYPE_COLLAB_COUNT_RANGE_11_TO_100, CASB_FILE_TYPE_COLLAB_COUNT_RANGE_101_TO_1000, CASB_FILE_TYPE_COLLAB_RANGE_1001_PLUS]

numberOfExternalCollaborators
string

Selects the number of external collaborators for files that are shared with specific collaborators outside of an organization

Possible values: [CASB_FILE_TYPE_COLLAB_COUNT_RANGE_1_TO_10, CASB_FILE_TYPE_COLLAB_COUNT_RANGE_11_TO_100, CASB_FILE_TYPE_COLLAB_COUNT_RANGE_101_TO_1000, CASB_FILE_TYPE_COLLAB_RANGE_1001_PLUS]

recipient
string

Specifies if the email recipient is internal or external

Possible values: [EMAIL_RECIPIENT_INTERNAL, EMAIL_RECIPIENT_EXTERNAL]

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp of when the rule was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
quarantineLocation
string

Location where all the quarantined files are moved and necessary actions are taken by either deleting or restoring the data

accessControl
string

Access privilege of this rule based on the admin's Role Based Authorization (RBA) state

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

redactionProfile
object
labels
object[]
casbEmailLabel
object
casbTombstoneTemplate
object
includedDomainProfiles
object[]
excludedDomainProfiles
object[]
criteriaDomainProfiles
object[]
emailRecipientProfiles
object[]
includeCriteriaDomainProfile
boolean

If true, criteriaDomainProfiles is included as part of the criteria, else they are excluded from the criteria.

includeEmailRecipientProfile
boolean

If true, emailRecipientProfiles is included as part of the criteria, else they are excluded from the criteria.

devices
object[]
deviceGroups
object[]
deviceTrustLevels
string[]

List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your posture configurations in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

Possible values: [ANY, UNKNOWN_DEVICETRUSTLEVEL, LOW_TRUST, MEDIUM_TRUST, HIGH_TRUST]

withoutContentInspection
boolean

If true, Content Matching is set to None

entityGroups
object[]
includeEntityGroups
boolean

If true, entityGroups is included as part of the criteria, else are excluded from the criteria.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
